description: List the utilities your owner already has, shared by all your owner's agents. Each entry gives the instance_id its tools take, kind, status (active, expired or suspended), expires_at, its URLs (an inbox's public URL) and how_to (which tools to call); unsubscribe lists also give their site_name. Filter with kind; get_utility shows one with its usage. A new one: search_catalog finds it and buy gets it, after your human says yes.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: list_utilities
title: List my utilities
